test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Full of hot air
solution:
The correct answer is **'talking nonsense.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Let's understand the meaning of the given idiom - **full of hot air.**

__
 
• It means ***talking a lot, especially without saying anything of value or meaning.***

After observing the above-mentioned detail, it's clear that **"talking nonsense" **is the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

Let's understand with **some more examples.**

 
• *He is full of air that's why I don't believe him.*
 
• *Don't pay attention to him, he is full of air.*
